term: probability-threshold full-belief policy and conjunction closure
definition: Accepted μ t A means t≤μ.real A for an actual Mathlib measure μ. Substantive applications require normalized probability and0<t≤1. ConjunctionClosed means binary intersections of accepted events are accepted; universal-event acceptance handles the empty conjunction, and finiteness yields finite-intersection closure. This stipulated policy is not the definition of epistemic reasons or independently justified belief.
